name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Lemon Cherry x Z Animal
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. This energetic cross of Lemon Cherry Gelato x Zkittlez x Animal Cookies brings a euphoric and creative high, perfect for social or artistic sessions. The terpene trio of Limonene, Myrcene, and Pinene produces zesty citrus flavors with a subtle cherry sweetness. Expect a vibrant, uplifting ride with each session.
